title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Part 7–Steel Ball Run
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In 1890, paralyzed former jockey Johnny Joestar enters a cross-country American horse race to learn the Spin technique from Gyro Zeppeli. The two fight assassins with supernatural 'Stand' powers while President Funny Valentine uses the race to collect the pieces of a holy corpse heavily implied to be Jesus Christ.
life_message: It holds up friendship, persistence and finding meaning through overcoming hardship.

content.note: Frequent assassinations and bizarre, gory fights (Wikipedia; AniList Gore 71%, Body Horror).
Grotesque transformations and body horror (Wikipedia; AniList Body Horror).
Nudity and a character's fascination with erotic asphyxiation (Wikipedia; MangaUpdates Nudity).
Johnny's despair over paralysis (Wikipedia; AniList Disability 88%).
